title: Additive selection_note overlay for the PHerc826 fit_rescue_v1 receipts

reason: The fit_rescue_v1 receipts are frozen Phase-4 evidence under workspace/archive/campaign-x-2026/legacy-phases/. Rewriting a frozen receipt to add a caveat discovered afterwards would destroy the property that makes it evidence: that it records what was believed at the time it was written.

RESCUE_LOCK.json is additionally bound by size and checksum in the Vast workspace backup manifest at workspace/campaigns/campaign-x-2026/runs/vast-workspace-backup-20260720/workspace-manifest.tsv:181727 (1933 bytes). Editing it in place would silently invalidate that manifest.
The receipts also live outside this task's ownership boundary.
why_this_is_an_overlay_and_not_an_edit.resolution: This overlay is purely additive. It changes no byte of any receipt. It attaches the selection_note that the receipts should have carried, by explicit path reference, and is discoverable from docs/SERIES_MULTIPLICITY.md.

selection_note: The fit_rescue_v1 configuration for PHerc826 was chosen AFTER the A/B result for this same target had been read. It is a post-hoc, target-specific configuration, and neither its gate outcomes nor its reported MAE, p90 or sign-accuracy figures are prospective or unbiased. Two independent selection events compound here: (1) the decision to attempt a rescue at all was taken for this one target out of thirteen, after its baseline A/B was seen; (2) the promoted relation weight was picked from a four-arm sweep in which every arm had already passed every gate, so the choice among them was made on the observed metrics. Any downstream use of PHerc826 fit_rescue_v1 geometry must carry this note, and the target must not be counted as an independent success in any per-target tally.

selection_event_1_rescue_attempted_only_.claim: PHerc826 is the only one of the thirteen eligible targets with a fit_rescue_v1 directory.
selection_event_1_rescue_attempted_only_.verification: Enumerating workspace/archive/campaign-x-2026/legacy-phases/phase4/targets/*/ shows fit_rescue_v1 present for PHerc826 and absent for PHerc0800, PHerc1203, PHerc1218, PHerc125, PHerc1447, PHerc1545, PHerc191, PHerc211, PHerc268, PHerc358, PHerc800 and PHerc813.

selection_event_1_timing.claim: The rescue lock was written after that target's A/B evaluation, not before it.
selection_event_1_timing.note: RESCUE_LOCK.json is itself explicit that it was written from the observed state: its diagnosis field records current_guard_area_cm2, current_safe_area_cm2 and current_satisfied_area_cm2 for this target, and its next_action prescribes the refit. The receipt is honest about being reactive; what is missing is the statement that this makes the subsequent numbers non-prospective.

selection_event_2_arm_choice_after_all_a.claim: The promoted relation weight was selected from four arms that had ALL already passed ALL six gates.
selection_event_2_arm_choice_after_all_a.consequence: Because the gates did not discriminate, the arm was chosen on its metric values. The reported MAE 0.109277, p90 0.235101 and 15/15 sign accuracy for r62w30 are therefore the maximum of a four-way selection over a 15-relation holdout, not a single prospective measurement. No multiplicity correction was applied across the four arms, and none is recorded anywhere.
selection_event_2_arm_choice_after_all_a.holdout_size_note: A 15-relation holdout selected over four arms is small enough that the selection effect is not negligible relative to the reported differences.

what_this_does_not_change: The rescue's central geometric finding stands on its own and does not depend on the arm choice: the TIFXYZ vertices already existed inside the exact ROI, and the area loss was caused by slab clipping, one-cell erosion and failed relation guards rather than by missing segmentation. That is a structural diagnosis, not a selected metric.

The receipts already carry ink_used false, external_generalization_claim false, independent_h1_validated false and scope GEOMETRY_ONLY_NO_INK. This overlay adds a selection caveat; it does not withdraw those declarations.

RESCUE_CLOSEOUT.md already states that the resulting ROI is an irregular connected component of up to 4 cm2 rather than an accepted 20x20 mm official window, and that evidence must be reframed into an official 4 cm2 region before any claim.
non_claims: This overlay does not establish that the PHerc826 rescue was wrong or that another arm would have been better.
This overlay does not establish correct geometry, ink, letters, or First Letters.
This overlay makes no external generalization claim.
